notes.title: Congo v2.0 Update! - LOCAL COOP NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7214805/6c3cb689192bb5a730aaf7b6be5db46b512d3f03.png

It’s been a while since we have posted anything or released an update for Congo. There has been many, many factors behind this both financially and personally, but we’re happy to say that we have finally managed to get together a new update for Congo with a number of very important new features and changes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7214805/f5175e699605a103d6e014929005bc43b9ac4552.png


 LOCAL / COUCH COOP FOR UP TO 4 PLAYERS
The biggest new feature is that we have now officially added Local / Couch co-op option for up to 4 players and enjoy Congo split-screen.

 CHANGED THE DEFAULT CAMERA ANGLE
We have altered the camera angle quite considerably. We think this works better, but please let us know your thoughts!

 ADJUSTED LIGHTING AND POST-PROCESSING
We have drastically increased the visibility for all levels. Combined with the new camera angle should mean exploring the jungle is a bit more enjoyable.

 FOCUS ON COOPERATIVE PLAY
You may notice that some of the menu items have been changed around and single player option is now missing. Congo is built entirely around cooperative play and playing with a few friends and we felt that the experience you get playing single player doesn’t live up to the coop experience. Because of this, we have focused everything on cooperative play, but if you want to, you can still play single player by starting an online or local coop match and starting the game without any other players.

 ADDED MORE SUPPLY BOXES AND INCREASED BIG GUNS
We have added more supply boxes to all levels, so you should have access to more equipment. We have also reduced the rarity of the AK-47, SPAS-12 and M16 so you hopefully get to use these more often!

 ADDED AND IMPROVED SOUNDS AND MUSIC

 GIVEN PLAYERS GPS AND 10 REVIVE NEEDLES AS DEFAULT

 ADJUSTED COLLISION ON ALL PROPS TO BE MORE ACCURATE

 TWEAKED GUI ELEMENTS

 TWEAKED DEFAULT CONTROLLER SETTINGS SO SHOULD BE EASIER TO PLAY WITH A CONTROLLER
You can still change the sensitivity settings in the Options menu.

 STOPPED MONSTERS BEING ABLE TO KILL YOU WHILE YOU’RE WATCHING A CINEMATIC

 TWEAKS TO MONSTER AI

 BUG FIXES


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7214805/bd5c43373d09c5395e28cc95a63b82416a982763.png

Some of you may also have noticed that the developer of Congo has changed from The Innocent Devils to Big Red Eight. Big Red Eight is still formed from the same developers (Jack, Tom and Jason!) but now we have cut free from the previous shareholders and investors and formed a new, different company structure that should hopefully allow us to work on our products and provide the support that Congo and the players deserve! For us, Congo is still a project we have to fit around our day-jobs and our adult(ish) lives, but now we are free from some company-orientated constraints, thinks should be a little better!

Please let us know your thoughts on the new features on the discussion boards. ːsteamhappyː

..And if you enjoy the new update, please let us know by leaving a review. It makes a lot of difference! ːsteamhappyː

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7214805/d83eb48a6ae7a765bdd1db37cafc74beb0ccf5ee.png

notes.title: v1.0b Update!
notes.notes:
Hi all you jungle explorers!

We have just released our brand new update - v1.0b which is available now. We have made drastic changes to the balancing in Defence mode. Demons now spawn at a more controlled and reliable pace, item drops and weapon crates are much more common.

We have also fixed a number of bugs regarding monster spawning in defence mode and objective mode.

We are also on sale this week for 66% discount. Enjoy yourselves! :)

notes.title: Congo v1.0 Full Release on 21st March!
notes.notes:
http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/Banner-01.jpg

Jungle Survivors!

Congo v1.0 (Full Release) will be available on Monday 21st March 2016 at 5pm GMT and the v1.0 release will come with a ton of new features, fixes and content.

We will also be releasing with a 25% discount, so for those of you waiting for the right moment to give Congo a go, next week is a great time!

Some of the new features to check out in the full release are:

New Levels - Objective and Defense
The release version of CONGO will have 6 Objective maps and 16 Defense maps. All new objective levels come with new achievements too!

New Camera Angle
After lots of feedback from you guys (and the introduction of our new tree hiding system) it has meant that we can adjust the camera angle to be lower, giving you a longer line of sight to see the demons coming.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/NewAngle.1.jpg

New and Improved Jungle
We've added in tonnes of new jungle plants and trees and the whole jungle on every level has been completely rebuilt! Check out the difference:

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/BeforeAfter.1.jpg


New Tree Hiding System
Our new tree hiding system quite literally cuts a hole in the foliage to see around you, eliminating some graphical bugs we were encountering and also enabled a lower camera angle.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/Screenshot.jpg

New Player Progression
You can now gain XP in a number of different skill sets that gradually improve your abilities such as run speed, attack speed and more, as well as being able to start each game with an array of items and weapons to give you and your team the edge the more experienced you become.

New Weather System
It can now rain in the jungle! The rain storms switch up the way you have to navigate and fight your way through the jungle.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/RainImage.jpg

Hundreds of Bug Fixes and Tweaks
We've plowed through hundreds and hundreds of bugs fixes that we have found and have been flagged you guys. We have also improved the AI system, control systems, menus and much, much more. More details will be available on Release day.

Let us know your thoughts - we'd love to get your feedback

notes.title: Apologies, Update delayed :(
notes.notes:
Hey adventurers.

I have some bad news on the update! Unfortunately, despite our best efforts some nasty little bugs made their way into the last build. A lot of them have come from our transition to UE4.8. An example of one of these issues is bouncy demons, where the demons seem to bounce off each other.

Theres also an issue with brightness and correlation to graphics settings. We are working on getting these fixed, but unfortunately couldnt get the build ready in time for this weekend.

The team is also away for the next few weeks so we wont be able to get the update out for at least 3 weeks which we are very sorry to have to say :(

We hope you can work around some of the issues present in the current version such as the Steam voice chat blockage. We have fixed this, and its frustrating that we're not able to just get that fix out. But if in the meantime you were able to use skype or similar then that would work and we'll get this sorted soon!!

Thanks again for your patience :)

notes.title: Update to UE4.8 and Progress Report
notes.notes:
Hey Congo adventurers!

We have been hard at work upgrading to the latest version of Unreal Engine and like all big updates in technology, it comes with loads of issues!

The main issue we were facing was that the game would consistently crash on load. As you can imagine, thats a pretty big problem, but it took us quite a long time to narrow down what was causing the issue and luckily we've found it now and it's been sorted.

This has stopped us from uploading new updates to fix some of the issues you guys have been experiencing such as the Steam Voice Chat issue where UE4 was blocked the Steam Voice Chat and limiting you to only the in-game chat which ended up not working... This has since been fixed.

There has been some massive improvements to the navigation system in UE 4.8 that allows us to build the navigation dynamically with a minimal hit on performance. In the current version, the demons would get stuck at certain parts of the level that change dynamically... This is no longer the case.

We have also made improvements to the AI system which drastically improved performance and we've also made some changes to the aiming system which we hope make for a more intuitive experience, but we'll need your feedback on that when we hopefully publish an update this weekend!!

Thanks for reading and your patience! We'll keep you updated on the release date of the next update.

notes.title: Update v0.2d Released
notes.notes:
Hey jungle adventurers! It's been an eventful few weeks, but we are now able to say we have released v0.2d (as you can tell there were a few developer versions before this release...) Not anything huge with this update, it's mostly to pave the way for the next update which will be a content-rich one!

Some of the updates and features of v0.2d:

Steam Achievements

There are now 13 Steam Achievements that you can unlock. We will be adding to these more and more as the game develops, but for now there are 13 to collect!

Control Menu

You can now view a list of controls accessible by pressing ESC or the "Start" button on Gamepad. Hopefully some of the more hidden functions will now be more obvious.

Show Player Names

You can now toggle to view player's names in-game by pressing Tab.

Fixed Unlimited Drop

Fixed a bug that meant that you could create infinite amounts of objects and items by dropping them.

Updated GPS

Updated the GPS to now only show the next relevant objective. Before, it would show all objectives based on distance, so would show you objectives that you couldn't access yet. Now you should only see the most relevant objective.

Bug fixes and Optimisation

Lots of little bug fixes and optimisations.

In the next couple of weeks, we will be releasing v0.3 which will include a new Objective level and four new Defense levels, at least one new weapon, new Achievements and more! :)

notes.title: Update v0.2 Released
notes.notes:
http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02OutNow.jpg

Finally! After a much longer wait than we first anticipated, we are now happy to tell you all that v0.2 is out now and available for you to download. There's some tasty new content, so here's a little breakdown:

v0.2 Changelog:


    New Game Mode - Defense

    Defense mode is a more traditional horde-style game mode where all 4 players must defend an objective for as long as possible, travelling out into the jungle where possible to collect supplies and equipment.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02-Objectives.jpg

    4 New Defense Levels

    Four new levels for Defense game mode. Fishing Village, Mountain Checkpoint, Military Outpost and Old Market House.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02-NewLevels.jpg

    Singleplayer Mode

    We have made several changes to make a solo-play experience more forgiving by adjusting spawn levels and item drops. We have also introduced a new item to help survival

    Hunting Knife

    When equipped with a hunting knife, you have the ability to kill a demon once they have jumped you. This is a one-use item and can be found dropped around the jungle. In singleplayer mode you will start equipped with several.

    New Demon Type

    Making more of presence in the jungle now are a new type of demon. Smaller, faster, more agile but less dangerous than their bigger brothers, they dart out of the vegetation and knock you to the ground, leaving you vulnerable to further attack.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02-NewEnemy.jpg

  Spectator Mode

    Watch your friends fail or succeed or be true heroes and revive you with the new spectator mode. Left-click to cycle through players and Right-click to switch between free camera or locked.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02-Spectators.jpg

  Voice Chat In-Game

  Press T to chat with the other players in-game.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02-PushtoTalk.jpg

  Update to Unreal Engine

  Updating to the later versions of UE4 has brought a number of improvements and optimisations.

    GPS Unit

    The GPS unit can be used to find objectives and useful checkpoints. If somebody is out to scavenge weapons, give them the GPS so they can find their way back!

    Re-work of Objective Mode

    Objective mode has been altered. Originally, there were checkpoints which you could capture which gave you bonuses.. We found that actually these were confusing so we have now stripped them out and just made those areas more valuable for supplies. We have also reworked the introduction video and is now a little clearer.

    Fixed Level Holes

    There are always sneaky level holes! We've blocked up quite a few... Hopefully all of them.

    Fixed Swarms and Spawners

    There was a strange issue with spawners and swarms where they weren't escalating correctly. It was hard to gauge difficulty levels but now you should see a significant difference.... Good luck!

    Foliage and Jungle Optimisation

    We have stripped out all the jungle and replaced them with UE4's foliage tool. Should look and feel virtually the same, but is now more dense and should increase performance.

http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/2/1152/1151830/v02-Foliage.jpg

  Bug fixes and Optimisations

Thank you all for your patience, let us know what you think of the new update. We will be doing smaller, more regular updates so stay tuned for what's to come. New features in v0.2a will be new in-game GUI, fully optimised Flare and a new system for sub-machine guns (plus the usual bug fixin'! :D)

notes.title: Update v0.1c
notes.notes:
Greetings! We have just released our v0.1c update, a few immediate fixes for some of the feedback we've been getting over the last few days. Here's our changelog:

 v0.1c Change Log: 
[olist]
    **Added transparency to leaves - foliage will go transparent if it blocks the camera**
    Added more informative loading messages
    Added progress bars for objectives
    Added more hint messages
    Fixed a bug where you couldn't access Inventory after being knocked down
    Fixed some level holes
    Various bug fixes and optimisations
[/olist]

Hopefully you'll enjoy the changes and makes the experience just that much better. There's also a few keys that may be of interest to you and seem a little hidden......

T - Takes ammunition from selected weapon and puts it in your stash

(that means you can strip weapons that you want the ammo from)

F - Drops currently selected weapon / item

G or I - Opens Inventory

Good luck in the jungle! More updates soon.. Including a new game mode - Defense, and 4 included maps!

notes.title: Pre-Release Update to v0.1a
notes.notes:
For those limited few who have access to the pre-release version of Congo, we'd like to announce our update to v0.1a, which features a few particularly useful additions. Most notably is the option to create an invite-only match, allowing private games with just your friends and a fix to an issue where Steam voice chat was disabled in-game.

Please remember that if you experience any issues, or just want to tell us your thoughts then head over to our forum which can be found at  www.CongotheGame.com	

v0.1a Changelog:


    Added Invite-only lobby
    Added control hints
    Added Intro video
    Fixed some level holes
    Fixed a bug where you could have infinite Revive Needles

notes.title: Pre-Release Update to v0.1a
notes.notes:
For those limited few who have access to the pre-release version of Congo, we'd like to announce our update to v0.1a, which features a few particularly useful additions. Most notably is the option to create an invite-only match, allowing private games with just your friends and a fix to an issue where Steam voice chat was disabled in-game.

Please remember that if you experience any issues, or just want to tell us your thoughts then head over to our forum which can be found at  www.CongotheGame.com	

v0.1a Changelog:


    Added Invite-only lobby
    Added control hints
    Added Intro video
    Fixed some level holes
    Fixed a bug where you could have infinite Revive Needles
    Fixed issue with Steam Voice Chat not working
    Fixed weapon icon showing when holstered
    Adjusted pop-up message boundaries


Thanks for your continued support and hope you have fun in the Congo!
